utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right? Teams is showing about three different microphones.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Nearly joined from the car park — traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Still less painful than the football last night. Ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You say that every Monday, mate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Monday 14 September. Let's get through the board before we turn into the sports desk. Finished stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, already swapped the filter on the stretch wrapper yesterday. That's finished, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, that's off the open list then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the line one yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, two completed filter jobs. I was looking at the old view, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: heard a slight rattle from the line 2 robot, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. We're not making that a new job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit, nothing we can do until they arrive. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Those aren't the parts for the boiler, are they? Sorry, talking over you.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, separate lot. The hydraulic parts are the ones we're stuck on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. I'll go to the water works to pick up the replacement parts for the boiler on Friday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum Reid. Friday collection for the boiler, normal priority — that's yours.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you chase the purchase order for the line one? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the line one. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just so we don't muddle it with what I said — that's the purchase order, not the filter job.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, separate thing. The filter's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you write up the near miss at the line 2 guard? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll write up the near miss at the line 2 guard. That's top of my list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the wording wants to be clear that it was a near miss. Not just a guard fault.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Absolutely. That's what I'll write up, the actual near miss.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the fire alarm panel by the 28th. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, Sarah — straight away on getting that sorted, with the 28th as the deadline? Not leaving it until then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Straight away, safety critical, and sorted by the 28th. Sarah Okafor against that one on the board.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, makes sense. Permit and isolation, not just a bit of paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While we're on that sort of thing, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Injection Moulding Line 3 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Risk assessment for work on the Injection Moulding Line 3, this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you take vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel by end of day? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll take the vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel by end of day, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the readings, yeah? Not a strip-down hiding under a nice short description?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Ha, no. Vibration readings only. I'm not volunteering for a barrel out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet tomorrow at 9:30? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that slot. I won't be available for those checks tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, over to David Whitfield then. Can you take the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet tomorrow at 9:30? Same urgency — that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that from Priya Raman. Pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet tomorrow at 9:30, first because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that production hold is the important bit. Not one to disappear down the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. That's the first-priority one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Callum Reid, can you inspect the main isolation valve for leaks tomorrow at 9:30? Whenever you get a chance, that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that, sorry. Not available for it at that time.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can that come over to you instead? Inspect the main isolation valve for leaks tomorrow at 9:30, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that one from Callum Reid as well. I'll inspect the main isolation valve for leaks tomorrow at 9:30. Whenever you get a chance — understood, lower urgency.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, both of those have tomorrow at 9:30 against you. That's the same slot.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I can see that. Keep the timing as stated; the Forklift Fleet checks are the production-critical one, the valve isn't.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, both accepted by David Whitfield, and the difference in priority is clear.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: There's also the bearings on the outfeed conveyor. They need greasing and checking on Friday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, grease and check the bearings on the outfeed conveyor on Friday. Anyone able to take that? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't commit to it. Just raising it because it's still sitting there.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't take that one on either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No owner for that, then. It's a need, not an agreed job against anyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, leave the outfeed conveyor bearings unallocated. Friday is still what's required, but nobody's taken it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just checking mine: I'll collect the replacement parts for the boiler from the water works on Friday. Normal priority. Not the blocked hydraulic parts.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I've got the low-priority purchase order chase for the line one, plus normal-priority vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mine's the near miss write-up at the line 2 guard, top priority. The Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit stays blocked, no action possible until the parts arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got the risk assessment for work on the Injection Moulding Line 3 this afternoon. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Both reallocated checks are with me for tomorrow at 9:30. Forklift Fleet needs doing first; main isolation valve is the whenever-you-get-a-chance one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the fire alarm panel permit to work and isolation is mine, safety critical, straight away, by the 28th. Right, that's the board.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Much better organised than our back four last night.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Low bar, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. All right, cheers everyone. See you on the floor.
